svg.title: inTandem architecture. The planner, terminal, and browser connect to one FastAPI bridge inside the inTandem hub. The bridge drives the supervisor, which talks through the neutral ImplementerBackend protocol to either the OpenCode 1.x/2.x adapter (on a lazy shared opencode serve host) or the Claude Code adapter (via the Agent SDK and PreToolUse guard). The chosen adapter edits your Git working tree and streams normalized BackendEvents back to the event pump while monitor and host watch run alongside, writing state on disk and sending alerts.
svg.text: Commands enter through one bridge. A neutral backend seam drives OpenCode or Claude Code.
FastAPI · one mount per task at /t/<task>
Runs specs, verifies results, guards files
Per-session claude CLI · claude auth login
Git branch or worktree · edits & SHA-256 checks
